name: HZ_ADDTNL_PARTYNAMES_INT
description: This is the interface table for additional party names.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for Import.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates action entered by user

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party ID. Foreign key reference to the HZ_PARTIES.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of party. Example Person,Organization, etc.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: User Key for the party.

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source System of party.

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Source system reference of the party.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source System of additional party names.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Source System Reference of additional party names.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for additional party names.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the name. It is a value defined by the Additional Party Name and Identifier Type entity. The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_NAME_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Record Status Flag used to soft delete entity. Possible values are 'A' (active), 'I' (inactive).

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Typically used to store the additional name for the party. In the case of Persons it will be used to store the formatted name if necessary for the name type.

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.description: A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.description: Used to capture the name prefix (Mr. Ms, Dr., etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Prefix in HL7. Validate against lookup CONTACT_TITLE.

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the first name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the middle name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description: Used to capture the Last name prefix (e.g. 'fon', 'van', etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the last name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the second last name for a person. In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Person previous last name.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.description: Used to capture the name suffix (e.g. Junior. Sr, the third, etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.description: Used to capture the Academic title for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Free text comment/description.

columns.name: TRANSLITERATION_LANG
columns.description: Used to capture the language used for the name.

columns.name: PREFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Identify the name as preferred name for this party within this name type. Possible values are 'Y' and 'N'. Default is 'N'.
